content:
infra-bot: alert: apiserver 5xx spike + leader-election churn in eu-west1 :rotating_light:
mira: seeing ~60% 5xx on LB -> controller-manager losing leader lease repeatedly
tony: controller-manager logs: "timed out waiting for leader lease" around 03:12-03:18, restarts every ~25s
zach: etcd tail shows short WAL fsync spikes (30-70ms) and occasional "i/o timeout" entries
lina: GPU attach controller reported ~95 attach failures in 8m, autoscaler kept launching replacements -> massive watch churn
oliver: NAT gateways conntrack at 91%, high TIME_WAIT on apiserver frontends :warning:
mira: sounds like ephemeral port exhaustion + disk jitter combo. can we throttle attach retries fast?
tony: deployed canary: provisioner attach backoff changed 5s->120s (exp jitter) in eu-west1
zach: bumped conntrack.max on NATs 65k->180k as temporary relief and added iptables SYN rate-limit for provisioner nodepool
lina: restarted controller-manager replicas sequentially with 45s grace to let leader settle :white_check_mark:
oliver: started short-term dashboard: alerts for conntrack>85%, apiserver_5xx_rate>0.05, etcd_wal_fsync_ms>25ms
mira: if this doesn't stabilize in 45m we should schedule moving etcd to isolated NVMe pool; ask finance for delta
infra-bot: incident note appended: runbook-ref: ephemeral-port-attach-throttle-v1
ton y: marking ops in-progress, will post metrics in 10m :coffee:
